translations.text: The Lord spoke through Haggai the prophet, saying:
Tell Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, who is from the tribe of Judah, and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the rest of the people, saying to them:
Who among you saw this house in its former glory? And how do you see it now? Is it as though it did not exist before your eyes?

Now, then, be strong, Zerubbabel, says the Lord. Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. And let all the people of the land be strong, says the Lord. Work, because I am with you, says the Lord Almighty.
The promise that I established with you when you were coming out of Egypt, and my [?] stood in your midst. Take courage.
For this is what the Lord Almighty says: Once more I will shake heaven and earth, the sea and the dry land.
And I will shake all the nations, and all the choice things of the nations will come and fill this house with glory, says the Lord Almighty.
The gold is mine, and the silver is mine, says the Lord Almighty.

For the later glory of this house will be greater than its former glory, says the Lord Almighty. And I will give peace in this place, says the Lord Almighty. I will give peace of soul as a means of well-being to everyone who works, coming together to erect the temple.
On the fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of King Darius, the word of the Lord came to Haggai the prophet, saying:
This is what the Lord Almighty says: Ask the priests about a matter of the law, saying:
If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and the fold of his garment touches bread, porridge, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy? The priests answered, No.
And Haggai said: If someone who is defiled, unclean in his soul, touches any of these things, will it also become defiled? The priests answered, saying: It will become defiled.

Haggai answered, saying, “This is how this nation is before me, says the Lord Almighty, and this is how all the works of their hands are. Those who come near them will be defiled; they will become unclean. Because of the early yield, they will be distressed in the face of their hardships, and you hate rebukes at the gates.”
Now, then, take this to heart from today onward, before stone was laid upon stone in the temple of the Lord.

For how were things for you when you piled up a heap of twenty measures of barley, and it amounted to ten measures of barley? And you used to go to the wine vat to draw fifty measures of wine from it, but it amounted to twenty.
I struck you with blight and with the disease of jaundice, and I struck all the work of your hands with hail. Yet you did not turn back to me, says the Lord.
Take this to heart from this day onward, from the fourth day of the ninth month, and from the day when the foundation of the Lord’s temple was laid. Take it to heart.
For they will be known from now on on the threshing floor. And even if the grapevine, the fig tree, the pomegranate tree, and the olive tree do not produce their fruit, I will bless them.
And the word of the Lord came to Haggai the prophet a second time on the fourth day of the month, saying to him:
Tell Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, who is from the tribe of Judah, saying to him: I will shake heaven and earth, the sea and the dry land.
And I will overthrow the thrones of kings and destroy the power of the kings of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and those riding in them, each with a sword against his brother.
On that day, says the Lord Almighty, I will take you, Zerubbabel, [?]
